verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript agent framework, so documented adapters that export its tools into other frameworks or SDKs are a fair question, but the evidence pack shows none for LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs. Building on the Vercel AI SDK, letting developers build their own MCP servers, and embedding into React/Next.js apps are adjacent building blocks or underlying dependencies, not documented tool adapters.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
